Name: Vanilla Tweaks Style Forage of Ferngill Seeds
Author: MarsCBG
Description:
Replaces the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8828]Forage of Ferngill[/url] Seeds and Saplings with ones in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] style.

[s]It has Saturation and Seasonal options, however due to limitations with Content Patcher they've got to be set separately from the main Vanilla Tweaks Mod.
[/s]
[b]NEW IN 2.0.0:[/b] Uses Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens to pull the Saturation and Seasonal options directly from the main Vanilla Tweaks - Farming mod. No more setting each mod individually!

[b][size=4]CREDITS:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Forage of Ferngill is by Stunky McDoo/Nrc5Skyrim
[*]Vanilla Tweaks is by Taiyo and Airyn
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Updated the mod to follow the Vanilla Tweaks update to saplings.
Now has a hard dependency on Vanilla Tweaks - Farming and Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens so you no longer have to manually set the saturation and seasonal toggles.
